resources.string: This app connects only to the PCs you paired — directly, or through a PC\'s Cloudflare Tunnel if you turned it on. No ads, analytics or usage tracking. The only other outgoing traffic is end-to-end-encrypted alerts through your push app\'s relay. Updates come through Google Play: the app asks the Google Play app on this phone whether a newer version is out.
New version %1$s — tap to update in Google Play
Asks Google Play twice a day whether a new version is out and notifies you once per version. Google Play installs it; the banner on the home screen shows either way.
